name: seis-agent-audit
description: Audit local agent evidence, cancellation and handoff metadata without executing agents.

interface.shortDescription: Review agent permission, evidence and handoff declarations.
interface.longDescription: Inspects bounded local agent JSON contracts for cancellation, evidence, audit and handoff fields. It never starts an agent or grants permission.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit agent evidence and handoff metadata in this local repository.
